item.title: Trump’s Super PAC Is Tied to Mystery Group Spending $25 Million on Midterms

item.title: Will Trump’s Midterm Convention Help or Hurt Republicans? 5 Things to Watch.

item.media:description: Normally, national party conventions are held only in presidential election years, but President Trump pushed for a Republican midterm convention.

item.title: California, an Environmental Bastion, Warms to Nuclear Energy
item.description: The state is considering extending the life of its last nuclear power plant, Diablo Canyon, and allowing construction of new reactors to help meet its clean energy goals.
item.dc:creator: Ivan Penn and Adam Perez
item.media:description: Established nuclear plants like Diablo Canyon in California tend to produce relatively affordable power.

item.title: As He Backs ICE Crackdown, Nebraska Governor Employs Undocumented Workers
